caption:
Your rest tonight is part of Allah's mercy

Allah tells us the night and day are from His mercy: one to rest in, one to seek His bounty. Put the phone down, rest well, and end the day grateful.

Surah Al-Qasas 28:73

Which favor from today will you thank Allah for before you sleep?

#restisamercy #nightroutine #gratitude #quranreels

Recitation: Abdul Basit Abdus-Samad
